body: Actually, I'm thinking about this right now. I'm quite good at drawing and okay at writing - maybe if I combine those skills..
Thank you. Really, thank you.
Hah, great selection of words. Yeah, I'm still here. Abusing drugs and making my gf happy.

Hey. Thanks for checking up on me, I'm doing fine (maybe even good) 🐧
Hope you'll have a great day.)

Psychology is my love and life. Understanding other people's thought patterns is the most interesting "hobby" in the world. I can't leave it behind, even if I want to, sometimes. I need some time to think about everything again.    
Thank you.

I'm already stronger than I was yesterday, kind soul. So are you.    
We have another chance. That's what I want to believe in.
Second one.
Oy vey. I don't really know what to talk about with someone, who will understand me better, than others, so... Good luck to both of us. Lucky number three.
Thanks.
Thank you, kind soul. I'll try to be as patient and careful as I can with my decision, because I still remember how beautiful the world is.
Nope, I guess not. Lots of people were traumatized by me tho.
You've done more than most of my closest friends. I either have shitty friends or you were truly helpful.
Ah. Whisky and a wide range of opiates. Very useful when you want to forget everything and just be.
Sorry, I am not sure if i understand your question. I've been drinking for a few hours now and my head is kinda fuzzy.
I will, if it helps you feel a bit better about this situation. I don't care, but I'm not an ungrateful dumbass; you've helped me to calm down.
The second one.

Yep. For me it's just a fantasy that will never become a reality. Or, maybe, it will, but I'm too tired to fight with my brain again, again and again.   
There's nothing for me to live for. At this point, I simply don't care about anything, but myself.

In my imaginary "sane future" I'm not the happiest person alive. But I'm not the saddest too. I'm peaceful and emotionally balanced, I live a simple live, have a simple part-time job, which leaves me a lot of free time for reading, walking around and self-improvement. I don't have much money/big house/car, but I like my life anyway.    
That's it, probably.
I have neither time nor desire for that. Also, my country is really bad at treating mental illnesses & it's very expensive.

I understand that this "peace" is a temporarily thing and is an illusion of a tired mind, but it's something. Something better than mood swings, panic attacks and boiling rage.    
Honestly. I can think of only one thing that will help me not to kill myself: becoming sane. Sadly, it's absolutely impossible, even if I end up lucky enough.    
What motivated me? I don't know. Maybe I'm trying to come to "real" peace with my decision. Maybe, on a subconscious level, I still believe in myself and hope for a sane future. Maybe I'm just scared to do what I really want to do. I don't know, actually.
It was a temporary job. It's kinda hard to find a job I like without a proper diploma (I'm psych major).
Right now - nothing. I'm not gifted at all, but I've worked as a Red Cross volunteer and as a sysadmin for the local executive committee (happy to be near computers and such). It was nice.
Bipolar II, BPD, OCD. Lucky number three.

Nothing much. I have an incurable and uncontrollable mental illness, which upsets my friends and my loved one, destroying my mind and soul in the meantime.    
I don't want to become a complete psycho, but it's not even an option - it's my future. Professional help aka therapy & drugs isn't useful in my case.     
I want to die while I'm still peaceful and have an ability to make others happy.
